# Pinned as is: census #11, every node is offered: _TRANSIT, the robot deck, groups, lanes,
# the disabled OLD-SLOT and GRP-OFF. No headings, no badges, label = .Name, value = .ID.

The form posts (a native POST /bins/create, gated by bins.js confirmBinCreate; the body is the
browser's): bin_type_id, label_prefix, node_id, quantity, status
On success: 303 to /bins. On a refusal: http.Error text, which the browser shows as the page
(see refusal-shapes.txt bins.create.400); no script reads it.
The same list is serialised again as PAGE_NODES for bins.js (Move, and the label check).
